description: Control internal job routes used by the preparation runner (GH-04). Control implements them in MC-02. Synthetic values only.

state.binding: run_id is the calling run (github.run_id); job_input_basis is the SHA-256 of the exact job bytes it received. When the dispatch response was lost (job still 'intended' without a run), Control binds this run to the job only if job_input_basis equals the recorded input basis and GitHub confirms the run is a workflow_dispatch of prepare.yml on main. Otherwise the reply is 404.
state.response_404: No recorded dispatch for this task, unit and attempt.

response_200.reason: run does not match the dispatch

run_id: The GitHub Actions run ID that Control recorded at dispatch (github.run_id). A re-run attempt keeps the same run ID; Control treats a repeated identical result as a duplicate.
